data.current_summary: Check whether a long trade clears after all costs (1 credit on success)
data.summary_suggestion: Validate long trade economics after fees and slippage
data.description_suggestion: Deterministic pre-trade economics check for long (buy) positions. Validates whether a proposed trade clears after accounting for exchange fees, bid-ask spread, slippage, and an optional profit buffer. Accepts trade parameters (entry price, position size, exit price, fees, spread, slippage) and returns a boolean decision plus detailed cost breakdown. Requires authentication via Bearer token. Consumes 1 prepaid credit on successful check; failed checks cost 0 credits. Same model_version and input always produce identical output. No market data, predictions, or trade execution performed.

data.description_suggestion: Deterministic pre-trade economics check for long (buy) positions. No market data, predictions, or trade execution performed.
